title: Affine intersection pullback section model
statement: Let f:X -> T be a separated morphism of schemes, U an affine open of T, Z an affine open of Y=f inverse image U, and g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X, fprime:Xprime -> Tprime a cartesian square over f and g followed by U. Let W=gprime inverse image of the image of Z in X, and let B be an affine open of Tprime. Set I=W intersect fprime inverse image B, A=Gamma(U,O), D=Gamma(Y,Z,O), R=Gamma(Tprime,B,O), and S=Gamma(Xprime,I,O). Let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module and M=gprime^*F. With the D-algebra structure on S induced by the restricted lift k of [def-pc-coefficient-intersection-ring-data], there is an S-linear map e:Gamma(I,M) -> S tensor_D Gamma(Z,F restricted to Y). For every section s on Z, e sends the restriction to I of coefficientPullbackGenerator(s) to 1 tensor_D s. No identification of S with a ring tensor product is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: The affine intersection base-change lemma makes W -> Tprime affine. Since B is affine, I=W intersect fprime inverse image B is affine. Restriction of F to Y preserves quasi-coherence.

Apply the affine pullback section comparison to k:Xprime -> Y on the affine opens Z and I. Swap its tensor factors and invert the bijective section comparison, obtaining sections of tensorPullback k(F|Y) on I mapped linearly over S to S tensor_D Gamma(Z,F|Y).

Compare tensorPullback k with pullback k by uniqueness of left adjoints. Compare pullback along Y -> X with restriction. Use pullback composition and k followed by Y -> X = gprime to identify the source sections with Gamma(I,M). The unit equations for these comparisons and naturality of restriction send the supported generator to 1 tensor_D s. Empty opens give zero modules, with the same formula.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_coefficientIntersection_section_model
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z))
    (B : T'.Opens) (hB : IsAffineOpen B) :
    let D := Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme, Z)
    let S := Γ(X', W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)
    let : Algebra D S := (coefficientIntersectionRingMap f U Z g g' f' sq W hW B).toAlgebra
    let M := (pullback g').obj F
    ∃ e : Γ(M, W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B) →ₗ[S]
        (S ⊗[D] Γ(F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι, Z)),
      ∀ s : Γ(F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι, Z),
        e (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ W)).op
          (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW s)) =
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[D] s
